description: This header file defines interfaces and classes for managing Bluetooth device information within the TR-069 protocol framework, including device discovery, pairing, connection status, and device info retrieval. It also includes definitions for Bluetooth-related object identifiers and string constants.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceInfoRdk_xBT
classes.description: Provides TR-069 interface for Bluetooth device information, including device discovery, pairing, connection status, and device info management.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the Bluetooth device info singleton instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of hostIf_DeviceInfoRdk_xBT.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the singleton instance.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming GET messages for Bluetooth device info.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming SET messages for Bluetooth device info.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for update notifications.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks and fetches updates for Bluetooth device information.
